info.name: Stream real-time run updates for a transformation

params.name: page
params.description: The page number to retrieve, used for paginated responses.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of items to include per page in the response.

params.name: file_id
params.description: A file ID to filter the list of runs that received this file as input.

items.docs:
Opens a Server-Sent Events (SSE) connection that streams live run updates for a specific transformation.

**SSE Events:**
- `connected`: Connection established
- `runs:new`: New runs appeared on the current page
- `runs:updated`: Existing runs changed status
- `runs:removed`: Runs fell off the current page window (e.g. pushed out by newer runs)
- `done`: All currently visible runs reached a terminal state
- `error`: Stream error occurred

Initiates multiple transformation processes for a specific transformation, identified by its unique ID. This endpoint allows you to execute multiple transformation runs simultaneously by providing an array of transformation configurations.
